scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the reference annealing curve from the paper's reported stretched exponential parameters (β=0.70, τ=760 s) and scores the agent's submitted fraction via MAE; this avoids dependence on unspecified model parameters while testing the model's ability to reproduce the experimental data.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference annealing curve (times and expected fraction_remaining) derived from the paper's stretched exponential fit for the E04=3.3 eV sample.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper's reported fitting parameters for the Ta=500 K anneal curve (β=0.70, τ=760 s).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Compute fraction_remaining = exp(-(t/760)^0.70) at 20 logarithmically spaced time points from 1 to 10000 s.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly calculated from the parameters reported in the paper, therefore they are the quantitative target of the model.

outputs.description: Annealing curve of normalized K0 fraction as a function of time computed from the phonon-assisted hopping model for the E04=3.3 eV sample. The checker recomputes the reference curve and scores via mean absolute error (MAE).

output_contract.notes: The agent must use the specific parameter set for the E04=3.3 eV sample as described. The reference curve is derived from the same equations and parameters.

steps.description: Validate CSV format, check time points match expected logarithmically spaced list, compute MAE between agent's fraction_remaining and reference stretched exponential curve (β=0.70, τ=760 s). Score full if MAE ≤ 0.05, linear decay to 0 at MAE ≥ 0.20.
